metadata.description: Playbooks published by PlaybookRun: skills and MCP servers per task.

plugins.name: dotnet-api-aspire
plugins.description: Official .NET and Aspire skills: Web API, EF Core, tests, AppHost wiring, orchestration, monitoring and deployment.

plugins.name: blazor-web-apps
plugins.description: Official .NET skills for Blazor: create a project, author components, forms, auth, data, prerendering and JS interop.

plugins.name: dotnet-testing
plugins.description: Official .NET skills to run, write and improve tests: filters, MSTest, coverage, gap analysis, test smells and testability.

plugins.name: dotnet-test-migration
plugins.description: Official skills to move test projects: MSTest v1/v2 to v3 to v4, NUnit or xUnit to MSTest, xUnit v3, VSTest to Microsoft.Testing.Platform.

plugins.name: dotnet-upgrade
plugins.description: Official skills to move .NET 8 to 9 to 10 to 11, adopt nullable references, check AOT compatibility and handle breaking changes.

plugins.name: msbuild-build-performance
plugins.description: Official MSBuild skills with the binlog MCP server: diagnose failures, speed up builds, fix incremental builds and clean up project files.

plugins.name: dotnet-performance-diagnostics
plugins.description: Official skills to measure and investigate: BenchmarkDotNet, dotnet-trace, dumps, performance analysis and crash symbolication.

plugins.name: dotnet-maui
plugins.description: Official .NET MAUI skills: environment doctor, Shell navigation, data binding, CollectionView, DI, theming, safe areas and lifecycle.

plugins.name: dotnet-templates-nuget
plugins.description: Official skills for dotnet new templates (find, use, author, validate) and NuGet: central package management and trusted publishing.

plugins.name: modern-csharp
plugins.description: Official C# skills: expert guidance, safe refactoring, C# scripts, P/Invoke, SIMD vectorization and the new .NET 11 APIs.

plugins.name: dotnet-ai-apps
plugins.description: Pick the right .NET AI stack (Microsoft.Extensions.AI, Agent Framework, MCP, RAG) with the official skill and current Learn docs.

plugins.name: windows-forms
plugins.description: The official Windows Forms skill: project setup, designer-friendly code, data binding, high DPI, accessibility and async UI on modern .NET.

plugins.name: azure-for-dotnet
plugins.description: Official Azure skills with the Azure MCP server: prepare, validate and deploy an app, instrument it with App Insights and diagnose it.
